第243章 真我唯我独尊（第1页）
天地间还回响着佛陀法相倒地时的轰然巨响。
那一脚踩落时，倒下的何止是佛陀法相，整座天地都在这一刻震动不止，已然超出了“人力”的范畴。
紧紧盯着眼前之人，灭天突然想起那日闯入他佛国净土，最后助他初步挣脱罗网藩篱的年轻人。
三人开始沉默下来，艾达升起了一堆篝火，三人围坐在篝火前，盯着不断摇曳的篝火，心里开始各自盘算起来。
狗蛋打开私信栏，然后点击了一下‘安方第一帅’的头像，进入他的信息页，那上面有他的用户编号。
骑着血虎的那个圣元将，仿佛还并未预想到杨凡会来，呆若木鸡的看向杨凡的手砸向自己。
看见李启这么说，末泷却不知道为什么多出了点信心，点了点头，将机甲交给了李启。
其次是景王的婚事，昨天他到安南王府下聘被赶出来的事，也连累她被人一通鄙视臭骂。
李维知道，这不是味道消失不见，而是他们正在逐渐适应这里的环境。
韩东气极反笑，将星光草收了起来后，右手一抬，黑曜刀浮现在他的掌心，握住后反手一撩，将对方的长戟挡了下来。
对方很奸诈的说道，指望让他把拿到手的钱再拿出来，是不可能的。
这是这么一句话，灵元子便觉自身真灵仿佛在这一瞬被拿捏住了一般，隐隐间连呼吸都变得急促了起来。
苏白眉头紧皱，无奈地叹了口气，现在的情况，是有点出乎他的意料了。
这绿瘴鬼烟和黑绛魔火都乃剧毒之物，只要沾上一点就足以致命，战龙几人看到战魂鬼菇，早就被兴奋冲昏了头脑，根本就没有防备，哪里来得及应变防守，全都一下中了剧毒，只能倒在地上挣命了。
而此刻的冷然，早就盯住了貌似阿炳的人，直觉告诉他，这一定不是阿炳。但阿炳的脸分明在他的脸上，估计已经是凶多吉少了，他心里凉凉的，怒目而视。
因为有必要在敌人对我们发动最终的袭击之前，将危险扼杀于摇篮之中，我决定讨伐黑暗五大势力之一的六魔将军，也因此与另一股势力“大鸦的尾巴”缔结了“贝加尔同盟”。
白蒙蒙的微光从我身前的躯体散发出来，伴随着魔力的涌动，当它消失时，可以从镜子里看到一身深红色晚礼服的姐姐。

又一阵冷风吹来，吹得他浑身起了一层鸡皮，马上又用心志把它强按了回去。
左贤王随着铁弗戎来到厢屋外面，抬眼一看，王府内的诸多高手都在这里候着呢，大家一看见左贤王出来，纷纷近前施礼，左贤王一摆手示意大家勉礼。
揭志贤皱了皱眉，显然遇到棘手的事了。他最怕的就是这种现场很多疑点的高坠，要做出他杀与自杀的结论没有中间地带可以选择，根本就是要他的命。=金＝＝榜=而如果一旦判断失误，无疑将误导接下来的侦查工作。
自从赫连托死后，左贤王与骨都府就没再有过瓜葛，更重要的是这位赫连锦彦从不在单于那里，与他争权夺势，所以，令左贤王对他的看法不同于赫连托。
然而，先前在宁无忧他们三人中原本最是护着韶华的洛无心却出乎她所料的，辜负了她的期待，成了第一个跳起来反驳她的人。

The heaven and earth still echoed with the loud noise when the Buddha's image fell to the ground.
When that foot stepped down, it was not just the Buddha's Dharma that fell. The whole world was shaking at this moment, which was beyond the scope of "human power".
Staring closely at the person in front of him, Mietian suddenly remembered the young man who broke into the pure land of his Buddhist kingdom that day and finally helped him initially break free from the trap.
The three of them began to fall silent, and Ada lit up a bonfire. The three of them sat in front of the bonfire, staring at the swaying bonfire, and began to make their own calculations in their hearts.
Goudan opened the private message section and clicked on the avatar of 'An Fang's No. 1 Handsome' to enter his information page, which had his user number.
The Saint Yuan general riding the blood tiger seemed not to have expected Yang Fan to come, and stared blankly at Yang Fan's hand hitting him.
Seeing what Li Qi said, Suetaki felt a little more confident for some reason. He nodded and handed the mecha to Li Qi.
The second was King Jing's marriage. The fact that he was kicked out of Prince Annan's palace yesterday also caused her to be despised and scolded by everyone.
Levi knew that this was not because the smell was disappearing, but that they were gradually adapting to the environment here.
Han Dong laughed angrily. After putting away the Starlight Grass, he raised his right hand and the obsidian knife appeared in his palm. After holding it, he raised it with his backhand and blocked the opponent's halberd.
The other party said treacherously that it was impossible to expect him to take out the money he got.
With these words, Ling Yuanzi felt as if his true spirit had been grasped at this moment, and even his breathing became faintly faster.
Su Bai frowned and sighed helplessly. The current situation was a bit beyond his expectation.
The green miasma ghost smoke and the black devil fire are extremely poisonous, and just a little bit of them can be fatal. When Zhan Long and the others saw the ghost ghost mushrooms, they were already carried away by the excitement and had no time to defend themselves. They were all poisoned at once and could only fall to the ground to save their lives.
At this moment, Leng Ran had already stared at the person who looked like A Bing, and his intuition told him that this must not be A Bing. But A Bing's face was clearly visible on his face, and he was probably already in danger. He felt cold in his heart and glared angrily.
Because it was necessary to nip the danger in the bud before the enemy launched the final attack on us, I decided to crusade against the Six Demon Generals, one of the five dark forces, and therefore formed the "Baikal Alliance" with another force, "The Tail of the Great Crow".
A white shimmer emitted from the body in front of me, accompanied by the surge of magic power. When it disappeared, I could see my sister in a crimson evening dress in the mirror.
Another gust of cold wind blew up, causing a layer of chicken skin to form all over his body, and he immediately pushed it back with his willpower.
King Zuo Xian followed Tie Fulong to the outside of the wing. He looked up and saw that many masters in the palace were waiting here. As soon as everyone saw King Zuo Xian coming out, they all came forward to salute. King Zuo Xian waved his hand to signal everyone to salute.
Jie Zhixian frowned, obviously encountering something difficult. What he fears most is the high fall with many doubts at the scene. There is no middle ground to choose between homicide and suicide. It is simply to take his life. =Gold==Bang= And if the judgment is wrong, it will undoubtedly mislead the subsequent investigation work.
Since the death of Heliantuo, King Zuoxian has no relationship with Gudu Mansion. More importantly, Helian Jinyan has never been there to compete with him for power. Therefore, King Zuoxian views him differently from Heliantuo.
However, among the three of Ning Wuyou, Luo Shaohua was the most protective.Wu Xin was beyond her expectation, he lived up to her expectations and became the first person to jump up and refute her.
